translation: 「誰在乎他們怎麼想？」

text: "A skilled warrior is a beautiful sight to behold."

text: "Bravery is not a strength of mine."
translation: 「勇敢不是我的強項。」

text: "An artisan, their materials and the tools to shape them!"
translation: 「工匠、材料，還有塑造材料的工具！」

text: "Everyone should broaden their horizons.  Any work beyond learning the basics is just a waste."
translation: 「每個人都應該開闊自己的視野。任何超出基礎學習範圍的工作都只是浪費。」

text: "Everything's alright."
translation: 「一切都還好。」

text: "Everything's fine."
translation: 「一切都好。」

text: "I could do without all of those creatures and that tangled greenery."
translation: 「沒有那些生物和雜亂的草木也挺好。」

text: "I do admire a clever trap."
translation: 「我確實欣賞巧妙的陷阱。」

text: "I finished up some work.  I am very satisfied."
translation: 「我完成了一些工作，感到非常滿意。」

text: "I'm doing alright."
translation: 「我過得還不錯。」

text: "I'm doing well."
translation: 「我過得很好。」

text: "I'm well."
translation: 「我很好。」

text: "I've been alright."
translation: 「我最近過得還不錯。」

text: "I've been well."
translation: 「我最近過得很好。」

text: "In life, you should work hard.  Then work harder."
translation: 「人生在世，應該努力工作，然後更加努力。」

text: "It won't turn out well."
translation: 「這不會有好結果。」

text: "One must always be loyal to their cause and the ones they serve."
translation: 「人必須始終忠於自己的志業與效忠的對象。」

text: "That isn't funny."
translation: 「那一點也不好笑。」

text: "The best way to get what you want out of life is to work for it."
translation: 「想從人生中得到什麼，最好的方法就是為之努力。」

text: "Why must they be so violent?"
translation: 「他們為什麼非得這麼暴力？」

text: "I consider laws to be more of a suggestion than anything."
translation: 「對我來說，法律更像是建議。」

text: "You must never forget true loyalty.  Repay it in full."
translation: 「絕不能忘記真正的忠誠。務必全心回報。」

text: "Some laws are just, while others were made to be broken."
translation: 「有些法律公正，有些則生來就是要被打破的。」

text: "Rules are there to be bent, but they shouldn't be flouted thoughtlessly."
translation: 「規則可以變通，但不該不加思索地藐視它。」

text: "Nothing gives them the right to establish these laws."
translation: 「他們根本沒有權利制定這些法律。」

text: "No law can do justice to the complexity of life."
translation: 「沒有哪條法律能充分兼顧人生的複雜。」

text: "One should always respect the law."
translation: 「人應該始終尊重法律。」

text: "Society flourishes when law breakers are punished."
translation: 「違法者受到懲罰，社會才能繁榮。」

text: "Always deal fairly."
translation: 「待人處事要始終公平。」

text: "Don't be afraid to do anything to get ahead in this world."
translation: 「想在這世上出人頭地，就別怕使出任何手段。」

text: "They are so full of all those big words."
translation: 「他們滿嘴都是那些故作高深的詞。」

text: "There is a time for artful speech, and a time for blunt speech as well."
translation: 「有時該講究措辭，有時也該直言不諱。」

text: "I can appreciate the right turn of phrase."
translation: 「我欣賞恰到好處的措辭。」

text: "Who are these mealy-mouthed cowards trying to impress?"
translation: 「這些說話吞吞吐吐的膽小鬼想討好誰？」

text: "Be shrewd, but do not lose yourself in guile."
translation: 「要精明，但別迷失在詭計之中。」

text: "I do admire a clever turn of phrase."
translation: 「我確實欣賞巧妙的措辭。」

text: "There's no value in all of this scheming I see these days."
translation: 「如今我看到的這些勾心鬥角，毫無價值。」

text: "It is best not to complicate your life with lies, sure, but the truth also has its problems."
translation: 「確實最好別讓謊言把生活弄複雜，但真話也有真話的問題。」

text: "Sometimes the blunt truth just does more damage.  Think about how the situation will unfold before you speak."
translation: 「有時直白的真話只會造成更大的傷害。開口前，先想想事情會如何發展。」

text: "Don't think about the truth, whatever that is.  Just say what needs to be said."
translation: 「別管什麼真相。只要說該說的話就好。」

text: "There are times when it is alright not to tell the whole truth."
translation: 「有時不把全部真相說出來也無妨。」

text: "There is no value in telling the truth thoughtlessly.  Consider the circumstances and say what is best."
translation: 「不加思索地說出真話毫無價值。要考量情況，說最合適的話。」

text: "Is there ever a time when honesty by itself overrides other considerations?  Say what is right, not what is true."
translation: 「難道誠實本身就能凌駕其他考量嗎？要說合宜的話，而不只是事實。」

text: "We should all work together."
translation: 「我們都應該攜手合作。」

text: "It's better to work alone when possible, I think.  Cooperation breeds weakness."
translation: 「我認為能獨自做事就最好獨自做。合作只會讓人軟弱。」

text: "Art?  More like wasted opportunity."
translation: 「藝術？我看更像是白白浪費機會。」

text: "Art is complicated.  I know what I like, but some I can do without."
translation: 「藝術很複雜。我知道自己喜歡什麼，但有些藝術我並不需要。」

text: "The creative impulse is so valuable."
translation: 「創作的衝動如此可貴。」

text: "What's so special about art?"
translation: 「藝術有什麼特別的？」

text: "Some traditions are worth keeping, but we should consider their overall value."
translation: 「有些傳統值得保留，但我們應該考量它們的整體價值。」

text: "Art is life."
translation: 「藝術就是生命。」

text: "We need to find a better way than those of before."
translation: 「我們需要找到比前人更好的方法。」

text: "We need to move beyond traditions."
translation: 「我們需要超越傳統。」

text: "Some things should never change."
translation: 「有些事物永遠不該改變。」

text: "It's admirable when the traditions are upheld."
translation: 「堅守傳統是令人欽佩的。」

text: "What do you care how I speak or how I live?"
translation: 「我怎麼說話、怎麼生活，干你什麼事？」

text: "I can see a place for maintaining decorum, but it's exhausting to live that way."
translation: 「我明白維持禮儀有其必要，但那樣生活實在太累了。」

text: "Life isn't fair, and sometimes you have to do what you have to do, but working toward a balance isn't a bad thing."
translation: 「人生並不公平，有時只能做不得不做的事，但努力尋求平衡也不壞。」

text: "Please maintain your dignity."
translation: 「請保持你的尊嚴。」

text: "Family is complicated and those ties be both a boon and a curse.  Sometimes both at once!"
translation: 「家庭很複雜，親情既可能是福，也可能是禍。有時兩者同時存在！」

text: "You can't always rely on your family, but it's good to know somebody is there."
translation: 「你不能總是依靠家人，但知道有人在身邊總是好的。」

text: "We cannot choose our families, but we can choose to avoid them."
translation: 「我們無法選擇家人，卻可以選擇避開他們。」

text: "I hold the relationships I've forged myself over family ties I had no part in creating."
translation: 「比起無從選擇的血緣關係，我更重視自己建立的關係。」

text: "Family is the true bond that keeps society thriving."
translation: 「家庭才是讓社會繁榮的真正紐帶。」

text: "I was always irritated by family."
translation: 「家人一直讓我心煩。」

text: "How great it is to be surrounded by family!"
translation: 「家人陪伴在身邊，多麼美好！」

text: "You can always rely on your family when everything else falls away."
translation: 「當一切都離你而去時，你始終可以依靠家人。」

text: "You should only maintain loyalty so long as something more important is not at stake."
translation: 「只要沒有更重要的事受到威脅，就應該保持忠誠。」

text: "Consider your loyalties carefully, adhere to them while they last, and abandon them when you must."
translation: 「慎重考量你的忠誠；該堅守時堅守，必要時也要放棄。」

text: "Never lose yourself in loyalty.  You know what is best for yourself."
translation: 「別因忠誠而迷失自我。你知道什麼對自己最好。」

text: "Loyalty has value, but you should always keep the broader picture in mind."
translation: 「忠誠有其價值，但你應該始終顧全大局。」

text: "Don't serve anyone blindly.  You'll only get into trouble."
translation: 「別盲目效忠任何人。那只會惹上麻煩。」

text: "The whole idea of loyalty is pointless.  Acting purely out of loyalty implies acting against one's own best interest."
translation: 「忠誠這個觀念毫無意義。純粹出於忠誠行事，就意味著違背自己的最佳利益。」

text: "How can society function without loyalty?  We must be able to have faith in each other."
translation: 「沒有忠誠，社會怎能運作？我們必須能夠彼此信任。」

text: "There is nothing so important that it is worth telling a lie."
translation: 「沒有任何事重要到值得為它說謊。」

text: "Everything is so much easier when you just tell the truth."
translation: 「只要說實話，一切都容易得多。」

text: "The struggle for power must be balanced by other considerations."
translation: 「爭取權力時，必須兼顧其他考量。」

text: "You should always tell the truth."
translation: 「你應該始終說實話。」

text: "There's nothing admirable about bullying others."
translation: 「欺凌他人毫無可敬之處。」

text: "It is abhorrent to seek power over other people."
translation: 「謀求支配他人的權力令人厭惡。」

text: "Power over others is the only true measure of worth."
translation: 「支配他人的權力才是衡量價值的唯一真正標準。」

text: "You can be powerful or powerless.  The choice is yours, until somebody makes it for you."
translation: 「你可以掌握權力，也可以任人擺布。選擇權在你手上，直到有人替你作主。」

text: "Friends are nice, but you should keep your priorities straight."
translation: 「朋友很好，但你應該分清輕重緩急。」

text: "Strive for power."
translation: 「去爭取權力吧。」

text: "Friends are future enemies.  I don't see the difference.  People do as they must."
translation: 「朋友就是未來的敵人。我看不出有什麼區別。人們只是做不得不做的事。」

text: "Building friendships is a waste.  There is no bond that can withstand distance or a change of circumstance."
translation: 「建立友誼是浪費。沒有任何關係經得起距離或境遇的改變。」

text: "When all other bonds wither, friendship will remain."
translation: 「當其他關係都凋零時，友誼仍會留下。」

text: "Be careful of your so-called friends."
translation: 「小心你那些所謂的朋友。」

text: "There's nothing like a good friend."
translation: 「沒有什麼比得上一位好朋友。」

text: "Surround yourself with friends you can trust and you will be unstoppable."
translation: 「有值得信任的朋友在身邊，你就會勢不可擋。」

text: "I only work so hard, but sometimes you have to do what you have to do."
translation: 「我只肯付出有限的努力，但有時還是得做不得不做的事。」

text: "Hard work is great.  Finding a way to work half as hard is even better."
translation: 「努力工作很好。找到只需付出一半努力的方法就更好了。」

text: "Hard work is bested by luck, connections and wealth every time."
translation: 「努力工作總是比不過運氣、人脈與財富。」

text: "An earnest effort at any required tasks.  That's all that's needed."
translation: 「認真完成該做的事。這樣就夠了。」

text: "It's foolish to work hard for anything."
translation: 「為任何事努力工作都是愚蠢的。」

text: "You shouldn't whittle your life away on working."
translation: 「你不該把人生都消磨在工作上。」

text: "Hard work is the true sign of character."
translation: 「努力工作才是品格的真正體現。」

text: "There's more to life than becoming great at just one thing, but being good at several isn't bad!"
translation: 「人生不只是精通一件事，但擅長好幾件事也不錯！」

text: "All of that practice is misspent effort."
translation: 「那些練習全都是白費力氣。」

text: "I think people should hone their skills, but it's possible to take it too far and lose sight of the breadth of life."
translation: 「我認為人應該磨練技能，但也可能過度投入，忽略人生的其他面向。」

text: "The amount of practice that goes into mastering a skill is so impressive."
translation: 「精通一項技能所需的大量練習，實在令人佩服。」

text: "The world isn't always safe.  I can see the value in martial training, the beauty even, but it shouldn't be exalted."
translation: 「世界並不總是安全的。我能理解武術訓練的價值，甚至其中的美，但不應過度推崇它。」

text: "We should all be so lucky as to truly master a skill."
translation: 「但願我們都能有幸真正精通一項技能。」

text: "Trade is the life-blood of a thriving society."
translation: 「貿易是繁榮社會的命脈。」

text: "All of this buying and selling isn't honest work."
translation: 「這些買賣算不上正經勞動。」

text: "Time spent in leisure is such a waste."
translation: 「花時間休閒實在太浪費了。」

text: "There's some value in leisure, but one also has to engage with other aspects of life."
translation: 「休閒有其價值，但人也得投入生活的其他面向。」

text: "It's best to slow down and just relax."
translation: 「最好放慢步調，好好放鬆。」

text: "There's work to be done!"
translation: 「還有工作要做！」

text: "It's good to keep pushing forward, but sometimes you just have to know when it's time to stop."
translation: 「持續向前很好，但有時也得知道什麼時候該停下。」

text: "Wouldn't it be grand to just take my life off and do nothing for the rest of my days?"
translation: 「要是能讓人生放個長假，餘生什麼都不做，豈不是太棒了？」

text: "Keep going and never quit."
translation: 「繼續前進，永不放棄。」

text: "Anybody that sticks to something a moment longer than they have to is an idiot."
translation: 「任何人在一件事上多花半刻不必要的時間，都是傻子。」

text: "All of this striving against one another is so foolish."
translation: 「這些彼此爭鬥的行為，實在愚蠢。」

text: "There is value in a good rivalry, but such danger as well."
translation: 「良好的競爭有其價值，卻也有很大的危險。」

text: "Some self-sacrifice is worthy, but do not forget yourself in devotion to the well-being of others."
translation: 「有些自我犧牲值得付出，但別因一心為他人謀福而忘了自己。」

text: "It's a competitive world, and you'd be a fool to think otherwise."
translation: 「這是個充滿競爭的世界，否認這點才是傻子。」

text: "We must be ready to sacrifice when the time comes."
translation: 「時候到了，我們必須做好犧牲的準備。」

text: "Why harm yourself for anybody else's benefit?"
translation: 「為什麼要為了別人的利益傷害自己？」

text: "Why deny yourself your heart's desire?"
translation: 「為什麼要壓抑自己心中的慾望？」

text: "People should be able to control themselves, but it's fine to follow impulses that aren't too harmful."
translation: 「人應該能夠自制，但順從不會造成太大傷害的衝動也無妨。」

text: "Some time spent in reflection is admirable, but you must not forget to live your life."
translation: 「花些時間反省很可取，但你也不能忘了好好生活。」

text: "I think self-control is key.  Master yourself."
translation: 「我認為自制是關鍵。要掌握自己。」

text: "It is important to discover yourself."
translation: 「認識自己很重要。」

text: "Why would I waste time thinking about myself?"
translation: 「我為什麼要浪費時間思考自己？」

text: "All of that so-called knowledge doesn't mean a thing."
translation: 「那些所謂的知識毫無意義。」

text: "Knowledge can be useful, but it can also be pointless or even dangerous."
translation: 「知識可能有用，也可能毫無意義，甚至危險。」

text: "There are times when it is best to keep your feelings to yourself, but I wouldn't want to force it."
translation: 「有時最好把感受留在心裡，但我不會強求。」

text: "The quest for knowledge never ends."
translation: 「對知識的追求永無止境。」

text: "One should not complain or betray any feeling."
translation: 「人不應抱怨，也不應流露任何情緒。」

text: "Do not hide yourself behind an unfeeling mask."
translation: 「別把自己藏在冷漠的面具後面。」

text: "Nobody is free, and it is pointless to act as if you are."
translation: 「沒有人是自由的，假裝自己自由也毫無意義。」

text: "Personal freedom must be tempered by other considerations."
translation: 「個人自由必須兼顧其他考量。」

text: "You should think carefully before embarking on a joint enterprise, though there is some value in working together."
translation: 「合作確實有些價值，但參與共同事業前，你應該仔細考慮。」

text: "I treasure my freedom."
translation: 「我珍惜自己的自由。」

text: "Why this obsession with weapons and battle?  I don't understand some people."
translation: 「為什麼這麼迷戀武器與戰鬥？有些人我實在不懂。」

text: "Masterwork?  Why should I care?"
translation: 「傑作？我為什麼要在乎？」

text: "A tool should get the job done, but one shouldn't obsess over the details."
translation: 「工具能完成工作就好，不該過度執著於細節。」

text: "I can take or leave merrymaking myself, but I don't begrudge people their enjoyment."
translation: 「我對歡慶可有可無，但不會反對別人享樂。」

text: "Bah!  I hope you aren't celebrating something."
translation: 「呸！但願你不是在慶祝什麼。」

text: "Merriment is worthless."
translation: 「歡樂毫無價值。」

text: "Be merry!"
translation: 「盡情歡樂吧！」

text: "It's great when we all get a chance to be merry together."
translation: 「大家都有機會一起歡樂，真是太好了。」

text: "We grow through debate and struggle, even chaos and discord."
translation: 「我們透過辯論與爭鬥成長，甚至混亂與紛爭也能讓我們成長。」

text: "Some discord is a healthy part of society, but we must also try to live together."
translation: 「適度的紛爭是社會的健康一環，但我們也必須努力共處。」

text: "I like a balance of tranquility and commotion myself."
translation: 「我喜歡寧靜與熱鬧之間的平衡。」

text: "We should all be as one.  Why all the struggling?"
translation: 「我們應該團結一致。何必爭來鬥去？」

text: "The mind thinks best when the world is at rest."
translation: 「世界平靜時，頭腦才能最好地思考。」

text: "Give me the bustle and noise over all that quiet!"
translation: 「比起那一片寂靜，我寧願要喧鬧與熱鬧！」

text: "Get me going and I won't stop for anything."
translation: 「只要我開始了，什麼都阻止不了我。」

text: "Maybe I give up too early sometimes."
translation: 「也許我有時太早放棄了。」

text: "There's nothing like a good brawl."
translation: 「沒有什麼比痛快打一架更好了。」

text: "Sometimes I think I need a drink, but I can control myself."
translation: 「有時我覺得需要喝一杯，但我能控制自己。」

text: "I am not governed by urges."
translation: 「我不會受衝動支配。」

text: "I could really use a drink."
translation: 「我真想喝一杯。」

text: "So I overindulge sometimes."
translation: 「好吧，我有時確實會放縱過頭。」

text: "Yes, I want more.  Is that so bad?"
translation: 「沒錯，我還想要更多。這有那麼糟嗎？」

text: "Why are they so fixated on these baubles?"
translation: 「他們為什麼這麼迷戀這些小玩意？」

text: "I don't handle pressure well."
translation: 「我不太能應付壓力。」

text: "I'm at my best under pressure."
translation: 「在壓力下，我的表現最好。」

text: "I'm feeling randy today!"
translation: 「我今天慾火旺盛！」

text: "I just don't understand these flames of passion people go on about."
translation: 「大家總是談論的那種激情之火，我實在無法理解。」

text: "W... worried?  Do I look worried?"
translation: 「擔……擔心？我看起來很擔心嗎？」

text: "There's nothing to be upset about."
translation: 「沒什麼值得煩惱的。」

text: "I look splendid today."
translation: 「我今天看起來棒極了。」

text: "Some people are so wrapped up in themselves."
translation: 「有些人實在太自我陶醉了。」

text: "We will be successful."
translation: 「我們會成功的。」

text: "I don't think I'm cut out for this."
translation: 「我覺得自己不適合做這件事。」

text: "Have no fear."
translation: 「不要害怕。」

text: "I was never one to follow advice."
translation: 「我從來就不是會聽從建議的人。」

text: "I'm not much of a decision maker."
translation: 「我不太擅長作決定。」

text: "I try to live and behave properly."
translation: 「我努力過合宜的生活，行為也盡量得體。」

text: "What's this about proper living?"
translation: 「什麼叫合宜的生活？」

text: "You're so perceptive!"
translation: 「你的觀察真敏銳！」

text: "You don't care, so don't ask."
translation: 「你又不在乎，就別問了。」

text: "I don't mind stirring things up."
translation: 「我不介意挑起事端。」

text: "It's so great when everybody just gets along."
translation: 「大家都能和睦相處，真是太好了。」

text: "I don't always do things in the most efficient way."
translation: 「我做事不總是用最有效率的方法。」

text: "We must be careful not to waste."
translation: 「我們必須小心，別造成浪費。」

text: "How I long for the beautiful spectacle of war!"
translation: 「我多麼渴望見到戰爭那壯麗的景象！」

text: "War is sometimes necessary, but peace must be valued as well, when we can have it."
translation: 「戰爭有時是必要的，但能擁有和平時，也必須珍惜它。」

text: "Nature can be enjoyed and used for myriad purposes, but there must always be respect and even fear of its power."
translation: 「自然可以供人欣賞，也有無數用途，但我們始終應尊重甚至敬畏它的力量。」

text: "Let there be peace throughout the world."
translation: 「願世界處處和平。」

text: "It's wonderful to be out exploring the wilds!"
translation: 「在外探索荒野，真是美妙！」

text: "These people carrying on about romance should be more practical."
translation: 「那些成天談情說愛的人，應該實際一點。」

text: "You shouldn't get too carried away with romance, but it's fine in moderation."
translation: 「別對戀愛太過著迷，但適度投入也無妨。」

text: "There's something to be said for trade as a necessity, but there are better things in life to do with one's time."
translation: 「貿易確實有其必要，但人生中還有更值得花時間去做的事。」

text: "There's nothing like a great romance!"
translation: 「沒有什麼比一段美好的戀情更棒了！」

text: "I have trouble controlling my temper."
translation: 「我很難控制自己的脾氣。」

text: "People can be so angry, and I just don't understand it."
translation: 「人們竟能如此憤怒，我實在無法理解。」

text: "It really gets me down sometimes."
translation: 「有時這真的讓我很沮喪。」

text: "How can people be so glum?"
translation: 「人們怎麼會如此鬱鬱寡歡？」

text: "Be happy!"
translation: 「開心一點！」

text: "Is there something to be happy about?"
translation: 「有什麼值得高興的嗎？」

text: "I get so jealous sometimes."
translation: 「我有時會非常嫉妒。」

text: "I don't understand how somebody can become so obsessed by what somebody else has."
translation: 「我不明白，人怎麼會如此在意別人擁有的東西。」

text: "Sometimes I just don't like somebody."
translation: 「有時我就是不喜歡某個人。」

text: "How can someone be so consumed by hate?"
translation: 「人怎麼會被仇恨吞噬到這種地步？」

text: "It's a great day to fall in love all over again."
translation: 「今天真是再次墜入愛河的好日子。」

text: "People do get so carried away sometimes, but not I."
translation: 「人們有時確實會忘乎所以，但我不會。」

text: "People should listen to what I have to say."
translation: 「人們應該聽聽我說的話。」

text: "I try not to interrupt."
translation: 「我盡量不打斷別人。」

text: "It's such a joy to be with people."
translation: 「與人相處真是一大樂事。」

text: "I prefer to be by myself."
translation: 「我比較喜歡獨處。」

text: "People are basically trustworthy."
translation: 「人們基本上是值得信任的。」

text: "My trust is earned, and not by many."
translation: 「我的信任必須靠表現贏得，而能贏得的人不多。」

text: "Everything just so in its proper place!"
translation: 「一切都井然有序，各就各位！」

text: "It's my mess."
translation: 「這是我的亂攤子。」

text: "Oh, I don't usually think much."
translation: 「喔，我平常不太思考。」

text: "One must always carefully consider the correct course of action."
translation: 「人必須始終慎重思考，怎樣行動才正確。」

text: "Do your duty."
translation: 「盡你的本分。」

text: "I don't like being obligated to anybody."
translation: 「我不喜歡對任何人負有義務。」

text: "I'm happy to help."
translation: 「我很樂意幫忙。」

text: "Why should I help?"
translation: 「我為什麼要幫忙？」

text: "I go with the flow sometimes."
translation: 「我有時會順其自然。」

text: "Don't bother trying to play on my emotions."
translation: 「別費心想利用我的情緒。」

text: "I can't take much more of this!"
translation: 「我快受不了了！」

text: "I feel angry all the time."
translation: 「我一直覺得很憤怒。」

text: "I just don't care anymore..."
translation: 「我已經不在乎了……」

text: "I feel so tired of everything."
translation: 「我對一切都感到厭倦。」

text: "Everything is all piling up at once!"
translation: 「所有事情一下子全壓過來了！」

text: "I'm feel like I'm about to snap."
translation: 「我覺得自己快要崩潰了。」

text: "I guess I just don't appreciate art."
translation: 「我想我就是不懂得欣賞藝術。」

text: "I cannot stand the world any longer..."
translation: 「我再也無法忍受這個世界了……」

text: "I encountered a fascinating conundrum recently."
translation: 「我最近遇到了一個引人入勝的難題。」

text: "A great piece of art is one that moves me."
translation: 「能打動我的，才是偉大的藝術作品。」

text: "Do you have dreams?  Tell me a story!"
translation: 「你有夢想嗎？給我說個故事吧！」

text: "Try to focus on the practical side of the matter."
translation: 「試著專注於事情實際的一面。」

text: "I need some more excitement in my life."
translation: 「我的生活需要多一點刺激。」

text: "I'd just as soon not have anything too exciting happen today."
translation: 「我倒希望今天別發生什麼太刺激的事。」

text: "There's so much to be done!"
translation: 「還有這麼多事要做！」

text: "What's the rush?"
translation: 「急什麼？」

text: "I'm concentrating on something."
translation: 「我正專心做一件事。」

text: "Huh?  What was that?"
translation: 「嗯？剛才說什麼？」

text: "There's no room for mercy in this world."
translation: 「這個世界沒有慈悲的容身之處。」

text: "Show some mercy now and again."
translation: 「偶爾也該發點慈悲。」

text: "I am a very, very important person."
translation: 「我是非常、非常重要的人。」

text: "Oh, I'm nothing special."
translation: 「喔，我沒什麼特別的。」

text: "Don't get on my bad side."
translation: 「別惹我。」

text: "You shouldn't waste your life on revenge."
translation: 「你不該把人生浪費在復仇上。」

text: "I like to dress well."
translation: 「我喜歡穿得體面。」

text: "I wouldn't feel comfortable getting all dressed up."
translation: 「打扮得漂漂亮亮，反而會讓我不自在。」

text: "One should always return a favor."
translation: 「人應該始終知恩圖報。」

text: "It's not a gift if you expect something in return."
translation: 「若期待回報，就不算是贈禮。」

text: "My goals are important to me."
translation: 「我的目標對我很重要。」

text: "I don't feel like I need to chase anything."
translation: 「我不覺得自己需要追求什麼。」

text: "Friendship is forever."
translation: 「友誼是永恆的。」

text: "I don't really get attached to people."
translation: 「我不太會對人產生依戀。」

text: "Everybody has their own way of life."
translation: 「每個人都有自己的生活方式。」

text: "I don't understand why they have to be that way."
translation: 「我不明白他們為什麼非得那樣。」

text: "I'm not going to change my mind."
translation: 「我不會改變心意。」

text: "Try to keep an open mind."
translation: 「試著保持開放的心態。」

text: "If you have a task, do it properly."
translation: 「有事要做，就好好把它做好。」

text: "It's not perfect, but it's good enough.  Why fret about it?"
translation: 「雖然不完美，但已經夠好了。何必為此煩惱？」

text: "I don't feel like telling you about it."
translation: 「我不想跟你說這件事。」

text: "I could tell you all about it!"
translation: 「我可以把這件事全都告訴你！」

text: "I wonder what they think."
translation: 「不知道他們怎麼想。」

text: "I'm curious.  Tell me everything!"
translation: 「我很好奇。全都告訴我吧！」

text: "I don't really want to know."
translation: 「我不太想知道。」

text: "I'm feeling optimistic about the future."
translation: 「我對未來感到樂觀。」
